identity.summary: Approved Full and Reduced masters, source geometry, and identity proof bytes remain unchanged.

palette.summary: Existing palette values and WCAG 2.1 AA rules remain unchanged.

typography.summary: Approved local font families, faces, and licenses remain unchanged.

platform_assets.summary: Regenerate PDF and portable guides from exact approved message roles, Brand essentials, and declared Usage limits. Approved logos, icons, and social compositions remain source-bound.

web_react.summary: Web and React adapter APIs and interface token behavior remain unchanged.

egui.summary: The egui adapter API and output semantics remain unchanged.

wordpress.summary: WordPress adapter 1.0.0 retains its public contract and uses the compatible Brand Canon 2.0.0 source tuple.

documentation.summary: Hosted, portable, and PDF guides publish exact approved roles and source-bound Brand essentials. The first hosted guide page uses its canonical route; published manuals link the exact release. Gate 2 approved site descriptions remain site-only; unresolved legacy descriptions are omitted from portfolio cards and public brand records.

recovery.summary: Regenerate all eleven site kits under Brand Canon 2.0.0 and BrandBuilder 3.0.0, then pin each new package ID and checksum. Eight release-authorized brand archives join the skill and portable distribution in the official release; three client kits remain hosted candidates. Old 2.8.0 packages remain immutable recovery artifacts.
